why: golangci-lint 2.15.0 fixed goutil.Env.Discover (a value receiver threw the `go env GOROOT` result away), so revive's own type check now resolves the standard library — but still not packages of the same module or of dependencies. The four permanent diffs this file used to hold (time-equal, epoch-naming, time-naming, and context-keys-type's "untyped string") were upstream failing to resolve *any* import; they are gone, guff's answers stand. What 2.15.0 adds and guff lacks: unhandled-error on fmt.Print / Printf / Println / errors.New (26) and one unexported-return, because guff's revive treats every import as invisible where it now needs "only the standard library is visible". docs/PHASE9-LEDGER.md §3.6 revive R1.
